observations.body: Paul describes a priestly mission among the nations. I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others. But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”
